definitions.explanation: The supreme governing authority of a state or the ultimate power held by the people in a democratic system. A fundamental concept in political science and international law.

examples.japanese: ⟦{国|くに}→国：02204_kuni⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{主権|しゅけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{守|まも}る→守る：01986_mamoru⟧。
{日本国憲法|にほんこくけんぽう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{主権|しゅけん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{国民|こくみん}→国民：02757_kokumin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Under the Japanese constitution, sovereignty lies with the people.

examples.japanese: ⟦{領土|りょうど}→領土：15711_ryoudo⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{国家|こっか}→国家：02760_kokka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{主権|しゅけん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{関|かか}わる→関わる：03020_kakawaru⟧⟦{重大|じゅうだい}→重大：01641_juudai⟧な⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧で⟦あり→ある：00006_aru⟧、⟦{簡単|かんたん}→簡単：00713_kantan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{解決|かいけつ}できない→解決する：17191_kaiketsusuru⟧。
examples.english: Territorial issues are serious matters involving national sovereignty and cannot be easily resolved.

notes:
USAGE:
A compound of {主|しゅ} (main, master) + {権|けん} (right, authority). Central to Japanese civics education. The concept of ⟦{国民|こくみん}→国民：02757_kokumin⟧{主権|しゅけん} (popular sovereignty) is one of the three pillars of the Japanese constitution.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{国民|こくみん}→国民：02757_kokumin⟧{主権|しゅけん} (popular sovereignty)
- {主権|しゅけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行使|こうし}→行使：14087_koushi⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to exercise sovereignty)
- {主権|しゅけん}⟦{国家|こっか}→国家：02760_kokka⟧ (sovereign state)
- {主権|しゅけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{侵害|しんがい}→侵害：11563_shingai⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to violate sovereignty)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{権力|けんりょく}→権力：10020_kenryoku⟧: power, authority — broader, not limited to nations
- ⟦{自治|じち}→自治：03985_jichi⟧: self-governance, autonomy — governance at a local level
